description: This file implements the CdmService class, which manages media key sessions, including creation, destruction, session handling, decryption, and querying supported key systems within a media server context. It interacts with media keys factories and capabilities, and handles session lifecycle and DRM operations.

classes.name: CdmService
classes.description: A service class managing media key sessions, DRM operations, and key system support within a media server environment.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Sets the service state to active, allowing media key operations.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Sets the service state to inactive, cleaning up resources and disabling operations.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates a new media keys handle with a specified key system.

methods.name: destroyMediaKeys
methods.description: Destroys an existing media keys handle.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session for a given media keys handle.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for a specified key session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session by its ID.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with response data.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes an active key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes a key session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID for a given session.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key ID is present in a session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Deletes the DRM store associated with a media keys handle.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store associated with a media keys handle.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Gets the LDL sessions limit.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error for a session.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Gets the current DRM time.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key systems.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts media data for a session, with an overload for different parameters.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a session uses the PlayReady key system.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for a session.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Increments the usage counter for a session.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Decrements the usage counter for a session.
